run_pretraining: run the DetCon-B pretraining experiment loop with JAX on a specified dataset directory
run_sanity_test: run a one-step sanity test of the pretraining loop using chex fake_pmap
run_train_loop: run the train_loop function with a PretrainExperiment class and ml_collections config
review_train_loop: review the train_loop function that manages JAX RNG splitting and per-step logging
review_main: review the main entry point that configures TPU backend and dataset loader kwargs
